ai.literal: Lowly association will fear greatness; meanness indeed as kinsmen surrounding will end up.
ai.translation: Greatness dreads and avoids the company of the base; but baseness embraces such company, treating it as its own kin.
ai.modern: பெருமைக் குணம் உடையவர்கள் சிற்றினத்தைக் கண்டு அஞ்சுவார்கள்; ஆனால் சிறுமைக் குணம் உடையவர்களோ அதையே தங்களுக்குச் சுற்றமாக ஏற்றுத் தழுவிக் கொள்வார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts how noble and ignoble minds react to bad company (சிற்றினம்). Greatness of character (பெருமை) instinctively fears and avoids association with low-minded people, knowing its corrupting influence. On the other hand, baseness of character (சிறுமை) naturally welcomes such low association, embracing it closely as if it were its own family (சுற்றமா). The poet uses personification to show that our natural affinities reveal our true character.

ai.literal: By the nature of the soil, water changes and becomes like that; for people, wisdom becomes of the nature of their association.
ai.translation: Just as water changes its character depending on the nature of the soil it flows through, so does a person's wisdom take on the character of the company they keep.
ai.modern: நிலத்தின் தன்மையால் நீர் தன் குணம் மாறுபடுவதைப் போல, மனிதர்களின் அறிவு அவர்கள் சேரும் கூட்டத்தின் தன்மையைப் பொறுத்து அமையும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful analogy from nature to explain the influence of association on human character. Water is naturally pure and colorless, but it takes on the taste, color, and quality of the soil over which it flows. Similarly, human minds and intellects, though inherently neutral, are deeply shaped by the nature of the people they associate with. Therefore, to maintain good character and wisdom, one must choose virtuous and noble companions.

ai.literal: By the mind arises to people understanding; by the association arises 'such a person' is called reputation.
ai.translation: A person's internal understanding arises from their own mind, but the reputation that defines them as 'such a person' arises from the company they keep.
ai.modern: மனிதர்களுக்கு அறிவு மனத்தினால் உண்டாகும்; ஆனால், 'இவர் இப்படிப்பட்டவர்' என்று சொல்லப்படும் சொல் அவர் சேரும் கூட்டத்தினால் உண்டாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts internal character with external reputation. A person's innate wisdom and understanding (unartci) are born of their own mind (manan). However, the world's judgment of them—the reputation (col) that declares them to be 'such a person' (innan)—is determined entirely by the company (inam) they keep. Thus, even a wise person will be judged poorly if they associate with low-minded people.

ai.literal: Showing itself as if existing in the mind, to a person, wisdom becomes that which exists in their association.
ai.translation: Though wisdom appears to reside in a person's own mind, it actually arises from the company they keep.
ai.modern: ஒருவனுடைய அறிவு அவனது மனத்தில் இருப்பது போலத் தோன்றினாலும், அது அவன் சேரும் இனத்தைப் பொறுத்தே அமையும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the powerful influence of association on a person's intellect and character. While it might seem that wisdom is an inherent quality originating from within one's own mind, the poet explains that it is actually shaped by and reflects the nature of the group or company one keeps. The word 'இனம்' refers to the circle of friends or associates. Thus, even if a person is naturally intelligent, their actual wisdom and behavior will ultimately align with the character of their companions.

ai.literal: Purity of mind, purity of action done, both, depending on purity of association, will come.
ai.translation: Purity of mind and purity of action—both of these will arise by depending on the purity of one's association.
ai.modern: மனதின் தூய்மை, செய்யும் செயலின் தூய்மை ஆகிய இரண்டும், ஒருவன் சேரும் இனத்தின் தூய்மையைப் பொறுத்தே உண்டாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights how deeply our environment and company shape our character and conduct. It states that both internal purity (purity of mind) and external purity (purity of deeds) do not arise in isolation; rather, they are built upon the purity of the association we keep. The word 'tūvā' functions as a participle meaning 'depending upon' or 'resting upon', showing that good company is the foundation of all virtue. Therefore, to keep one's thoughts and actions pure, one must first ensure that their circle of friends and associates is pure.

ai.literal: To those pure of mind, legacy will become good; to those pure of association, there is no action that does not become good.
ai.translation: For those who are pure of mind, their legacy will be good; for those who are pure in their association, there is no action that does not turn out well.
ai.modern: மனம் தூய்மையாக இருப்பவர்களுக்கு அவர்களுடைய சந்ததி நன்மையாக அமையும்; நல்லினத்தைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு நன்மையாக முடியாத செயல் என்று எதுவும் இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts the benefits of internal purity of mind with external purity of association. A pure mind ensures that one's legacy or offspring (eccam) turns out well, preserving one's goodness for the future. On the other hand, keeping pure company ensures that every action (vinai) one undertakes in the present succeeds and yields good results. Thus, while mental purity secures a lasting legacy, choosing the right association guarantees immediate success in all endeavors.

ai.translation: Goodness of mind brings prosperity to living beings, but goodness of association brings them all glory.
ai.modern: மனதின் நன்மையானது நிலைபெற்ற உயிர்களுக்கு ஆக்கத்தைத் தரும்; நல்லினத்தின் சேர்க்கையானது எல்லாப் புகழையும் தரும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts the internal virtue of a pure mind with the external virtue of good companionship. Goodness of mind (மனநலம்) is essential for an individual's personal growth and brings prosperity (ஆக்கம்) to their life. However, goodness of association (இனநலம்) goes even further by bringing complete glory and recognition (எல்லாப் புகழும்) in the wider world. While a pure mind elevates one's character, the company one keeps determines how one is perceived and praised by society.

The word 'ஏமாப்பு' means protection or strength, highlighting that even the virtuous need a supportive environment to maintain their virtue. Thus, the company we keep reinforces and safeguards our inherent goodness.

ai.literal: By goodness of mind is attained the next world; and even that, by goodness of association, protection possesses.
ai.translation: The bliss of the next world is attained through goodness of mind; yet, even that goodness of mind finds its secure protection in the goodness of one's association.
ai.modern: மனத்தூய்மையினால் மறுமை இன்பம் உண்டாகும்; ஆனால், அந்த மனத்தூய்மையும் நல்லினத்தின் சேர்க்கையால்தான் வலிமை பெறும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the relationship between a pure mind and good company. While goodness of mind (மனநலம்) is essential to attain the virtues and rewards of the next life (மறுமை), that mental purity itself is not self-sustaining. It requires the safety, support, and reinforcement (ஏமாப்பு) that comes from being associated with good people (இனநலம்). Thus, keeping good company is the ultimate safeguard for one's own character and destiny.

ai.literal: Than good association, greater companion there is not; than evil association, suffering that which causes also there is not.
ai.translation: There is no companion greater than good association, and there is nothing that brings more suffering than evil association.
ai.modern: நல்ல சேர்க்கையை விடச் சிறந்த துணை வேறு இல்லை; தீய சேர்க்கையை விடத் துன்பத்தைத் தருவது வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the powerful influence of the company we keep. The poet uses a parallel structure to contrast good and bad associations. Good company is described as the ultimate support system, with no helper or companion ('துணை') exceeding it. Conversely, bad company is identified as the ultimate source of misery, with nothing else causing as much deep suffering ('அல்லல்'). The word 'படுப்பதூஉம்' uses a poetic elongation to emphasize the inevitable and heavy toll that bad associations inflict on a person.
